_stale.reason: Generated before the split-calendar correction existed: zero 'Split adjustment applied' warnings, and the assumption text still says splits are not modeled. Figures understate returns for split-affected symbols (see docs/US_STOCK_PRICE_ADJUSTMENT_POLICY_20261105.md).

assumptions.split: 70% IS; shared 253-session purge; all five OOS segments independently initialized in cash
assumptions.baseline_native_splits: Engine remains unchanged: low-vol native purge 61, EW 0; runner uses matched 253 for reported OOS
assumptions.switch_count: Scheduled R changes, excluding initial cash-to-sleeve entry; sleeve changes separately reported
assumptions.diagnostics: Daily R is hypothetical between rebalances; held target sleeve is carried. Session return includes old-sleeve overnight P&L on switch day. Cost-rate sums are equity fractions, not dollars; CAGR drag is measured by a zero-cost rerun.
assumptions.growth_shortfall: Each selected growth asset has fixed 20%; fewer than five leaves residual cash
assumptions.daily_variant: Diagnostic full daily re-selection/rebalancing, not a one-way emergency exit and not primary adoption candidate

results.name: Risk-on / defensive rotation

strategy.name: Risk-on / defensive rotation
strategy.description: Frozen S-05 same-universe comparison; lagged signals and next-open execution.

assumptions: Annualization: 252 observations per year for CAGR, Sharpe, Sortino, turnover and bootstrap CAGR; Calmar uses annualized CAGR.
Signals use only data dated before execution; orders execute at next session open.
Fundamental value signals require pbr, per, net_cash_ratio or kiyohara_net_cash_ratio, and disclosure_date in OHLCV rows; missing or not-yet-disclosed records are excluded, never imputed.

Defensive rotation: R = (SPY last 20-session return > 0) AND (SPY close(t-1) > SMA100(t-1)), using only closes strictly before execution. Equality, insufficient or invalid history fails closed to risk-off. Risk-on: top five 252-21 momentum assets receive 20% each; missing slots remain cash. Risk-off: lowest sample-sigma60 of JNJ/PG/XOM/JPM intersected with universe, up to three assets at equal 1/N; non-finite sigma excluded. Every nonselected asset has explicit zero weight; no candidates means full liquidation into interest-free USD cash. Generic weighting and max_positions are ignored; no leverage. Configured rebalance: monthly; warmup/purge: 253 closes/sessions.
Pre-start OHLCV is only for lookback; returns use the requested interval.
Overnight returns use previous weights; intraday returns use post-rebalance weights.
Weights drift between rebalances; turnover and costs use gross buys plus sells.
Costs: 10 bps commission + 5 bps slippage, charged on one-way traded notional.
Raw OHLCV is used; dividends, split adjustments, taxes, market impact, borrow costs, and delisting returns are not modeled.
The configured universe is fixed, not point-in-time; survivorship bias may remain.
Bootstrap: IID daily-return resampling, 95% percentile interval, seed 20260930; not a forecast interval.
